results.name: Browser and CommonJS builds expose the same API
Ten levels in all, the first four free, and each of these has ten waves
Every bud starts on the board, never overlaps another, and sways inside the walls
Rocks and the leaf sit between the flowers and the launcher, clear of every opening bud
Each level brings its own twist and ends with a tougher boss
Cups turn away shots from below, but a shot from above or a crown blooms them
A puffcap blooms everything within reach and nothing past it
A boss that reaches the line costs a life and climbs back; blooming it blooms its wave
Drops wait for their time and for room at the top, and the wave only clears after the last one
Crystals slide, the leaf keeps its turn between waves, and turning never moves a rock
Swaying buds move side to side and fast ones fall faster
Progress saves stars, best score and furthest wave; levels open in order
A practice bot clears every free level, and the levels get harder in order
